title: Temple Tablets with the extra-Crystal suffix
summary: Roll Temple Tablets for the suffix that gives each Vaal Beacon a chance at an extra Crystal, and sell them in threes to players who run Atziri's Temple: a map takes at most three tablets.

budget.why: Temple Tablets and cheap orbs (Transmutation, Augmentation, Alchemy); a Divine Orb only to push a finished roll toward 10%.
budget.build_needs: None for the rolling; Temple Tablets come from ordinary maps.

claim.note: Our reading of the method against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No combat: the method is rolling in the stash and selling.

claim.note: Not rated: the build scale measures map content, and this method has none.

complexity.why: The complexity scale is written for map setups, not for rolling at the stash.

claim.note: Not rated: no step of the scale describes a rolling loop.

durability.why_it_works: The extra-Crystal suffix rolls only on Temple Tablets, and Crystals are what build Atziri's Temple, so temple farmers keep buying it.
breaks_when: The suffix is cut or moved off the base
Crystal payouts or Temple rules change so Crystals stop limiting runs
Temple farming falls out of use

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.
Base IncursionAugment: 'Adds Vaal Beacons to a Map', 10 uses.

target_mods.text: (5–10)% chance to gain an additional Crystal from Vaal Beacons in Map

claim.note: RePoE mod TowerIncursionTokenChance, a suffix that rolls only on Temple Tablets.

roll_steps.action: Magic route: Orb of Transmutation, then Orb of Augmentation; a tablet that misses the suffix can be made rare with an Orb of Alchemy for another chance at it.

claim.note: Our route from the currency texts; none of the temple videos we checked shows how its author rolls Temple Tablets.

roll_steps.action: Rare route: with an Omen of Dextral Erasure active, a Chaos Orb removes only a suffix, so the prefixes stay while the suffix slot rerolls (the added mod is still random).

claim.note: The omen's poe2db text names no item class, but no source we cite shows it on a tablet: test it on a cheap tablet first.

roll_steps.action: Divine Orb to reroll the value toward 10%, before anything corrupts the tablet.

claim.note: A Divine Orb randomises modifier values; an Ancient Infuser corrupts the tablet, after which it cannot be rerolled.

demand.why: Vaal Beacons pay out the Crystals that build Atziri's Temple (6 per console, storage cap 60), and temple farmers run three Temple Tablets with this suffix per map, so a matched set of three is what one map uses.

claim.note: Crystal figures from poe2db. Three per map: DEADRABB1T (2026-06-05, 8:23) and Path of Evening (2026-07-02, 6:44); Diztoh (2026-09-29, 1:08) stacks 'multiple'. Selling in threes is our conclusion, not a creator's.

risks: A map takes at most three tablets (the 0.3.1 patch notes tie the third slot to waystone modifiers), so a set of three is the most one map uses.
An Ancient Infuser corrupts a tablet and can destroy it; it never raises a value.
Tablets are not on the currency exchange: price a set on the trade site with the Search link.
